name: What common bedroom safety upgrades are recommended for older homes?

mainEntity.name: What common bedroom safety upgrades are recommended for older homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For older homes in the Bay Area, common bedroom safety upgrades include updating electrical wiring to prevent fire hazards, installing interconnected smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, and ensuring windows have secure locks. Adding nightlights or motion-sensor lighting can improve visibility and prevent falls. Consider securing heavy furniture to walls to prevent tipping, especially if children or pets are present. Upgrading to shatter-resistant window glass or installing security film can also enhance safety. We focus on practical, effective solutions that blend with your home's existing aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Recommended upgrades for older homes include electrical updates, interconnected smoke/CO detectors, secure window locks, and motion-sensor lighting to prevent falls.
